name: GummySearch exit migration monitor
buyer: Bootstrapped founders and indie marketers who used GummySearch for Reddit audience research and lead-finding
pain: GummySearch stopped new signups and payments on 2025-11-30 and shuts down fully on 2026-12-01, so users must rebuild saved audiences and keyword monitors elsewhere.
wedge: A time-boxed 'GummySearch exit' tool that rebuilds a user's exported audiences or keyword lists as monitors at about $8/mo. It would be a thin importer on top of existing data sources. The window closes with the Dec 2026 shutdown.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Price a thin monitor and importer at about $8/mo. Compute cost is small, but the data-source and API cost is unverified.
scan1Edge.falsifier: RedNudge already sells at $7/month (C11), and if GummySearch exports are unavailable there is nothing to import. Either one means no real edge.

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: ESTIMATE from the research notes: 60-70% gross margin, driven by data-source costs. Not a sourced figure.

majorUncertainty: Whether GummySearch exports exist and whether a window remains before the Dec 2026 shutdown, given that several competitors already target these users.
unknowns: Whether GummySearch audiences or keyword lists can be exported
The 60-70% conversation-miss claim is a vendor claim and unverified
No direct user complaints were found
The $35K MRR figure comes from one source only
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Heavy dependence on Reddit API terms and pricing, the same cause as GummySearch's closure.
